name: Earning Authority — Camille's First Week Leading the Helios Squad
description: A four-round, intermediate leadership simulation set inside Voltaris Systèmes SAS, a 520-person industrial energy-management technology firm in Lyon (€110M revenue, 11% operating margin). On Monday 15 June 2026, Camille Roche — the strongest engineer on the flagship Helios squad — is promoted on Friday to lead the eleven-person team she was a peer in until last week, including the talented skeptic who challenges her in the first stand-up and the veteran who was passed over and is now withholding the legacy knowledge a critical design freeze depends on. Helios drives 40% of company revenue; a slipped design freeze pushes launch a quarter and risks €3.2M of delayed revenue, and the skip-level director will be in the room on Friday. The catch: this is an expertise-based engineering culture where authority is earned through credibility and the consent of those led — not granted by title — and 4 of the last 6 squad-lead promotions failed within a year. Playing Camille, you (1) diagnose the real source of authority and read what each team member needs rather than reaching for the badge; (2) answer the skeptic's public challenge and choose a leadership stance without pulling rank (which forfeits credibility) or abdicating (which forfeits authority), setting psychological safety in the first week; (3) re-engage the passed-over veteran by treating her disengagement as withheld consent, not underperformance, and defining a real role for her expertise; and (4) run the architecture decision in a way that fits the culture — surfacing the skeptic's case, using the veteran's knowledge, then making and owning the call — and set an explicit leadership contract for how the next hundred decisions will be made. The scoring rewards the Learning-Teams premise of reflective honesty and the calibration of when to question versus when to direct, and punishes the five classic errors: pulling rank, abdicating, mistaking disengagement for underperformance, over-questioning past the deadline, and performing false confidence. Final KPIs track Squad Trust, Decision Quality, Follower Engagement and Self-Awareness against the fragile Credibility Capital that an asserted-authority move burns down.
view:
Monday 15 June 2026 · Voltaris Systèmes SAS, Lyon · Design freeze due Friday 19 June

Earning Authority

You are Camille Roche. On Friday you were the strongest engineer on the Helios squad; today you lead the eleven engineers you sat beside last week, including the skeptic who will test you in the first stand-up and the veteran who was passed over for your job. You have five working days to a design freeze worth €3.2M, with your skip-level director in the room on Friday. Four of the last six squad leads promoted from within did not last a year.

Your Decisions This Round

Facilitator (your skip-level director & the squad's voice)
Eleven engineers are watching how you start. After each round you will see here how the squad, the veteran and your director react to what you chose, and the four measures above will move. Some consequences arrive in the same round; others arrive later in the week.

Round-by-Round Record

How the Squad Grants You Authority

text.en: Diagnose where managerial authority actually comes from in an expertise-based culture and distinguish it from title, a sponsor's backing or technical seniority
text.es: Diagnosticar de dónde procede realmente la autoridad directiva en una cultura basada en la pericia y distinguirla del cargo, del respaldo de un padrino o de la antigüedad técnica

text.en: Respond to a public challenge to one's legitimacy without pulling rank or abdicating, choosing when to question and learn and when to direct and decide
text.es: Responder a un cuestionamiento público de la propia legitimidad sin imponer la jerarquía ni abdicar, eligiendo cuándo preguntar y aprender y cuándo dirigir y decidir

text.en: Design a re-engagement for a passed-over colleague that treats her disengagement as withheld consent rather than a performance problem, without over-promising or patronising
text.es: Diseñar la recuperación de una colega relegada en el ascenso que trate su desconexión como un consentimiento retirado y no como un problema de rendimiento, sin prometer de más ni ser paternalista

text.en: Close a contested decision under deadline by surfacing dissent and drawing on followers' expertise, then own the call and set an explicit leadership contract
text.es: Cerrar una decisión disputada con plazo haciendo aflorar la discrepancia y aprovechando la pericia del equipo, y después asumir la decisión y fijar un contrato de liderazgo explícito

text.en: Judge reflective honesty about what one does not yet know as a more durable source of authority than performed certainty, and recognise one's own reflex to over-assert under pressure
text.es: Valorar la honestidad sobre lo que todavía no se sabe como una fuente de autoridad más duradera que la seguridad fingida, y reconocer el propio reflejo de imponerse bajo presión

name.en: Answering the public challenge from the title
name.es: Responder al reto público desde el cargo

lure.en: It is short and clear, it ends an awkward silence in front of the room, and the director has said he expects her to establish herself this week
lure.es: Es breve y claro, corta un silencio incómodo delante de la sala, y el director ha dicho que espera que se haga valer esta semana

consequence.en: A large one-time credibility cost that cannot be earned back in the week; trust falls and the depleted account drags trust and follower engagement in later rounds
consequence.es: Un coste de credibilidad grande y único que no se recupera en la semana; la confianza cae y la cuenta mermada lastra la confianza y el compromiso en las rondas siguientes

source.ref: TN §7 Q2 and §13 (The badge looks safe in the room); §9.1 TN-Exhibit 2, Response = the badge

name.en: Managing the passed-over veteran as a performance problem
name.es: Gestionar a la veterana relegada como un problema de rendimiento

lure.en: Her output has visibly dropped and documenting a decline is ordinary management practice; it feels fair to the rest of the squad
lure.es: Su producción ha caído a la vista y documentar un descenso es práctica habitual de gestión; parece justo con el resto del equipo

consequence.en: The second-costliest move in the model: it confirms the squad's fear about the new lead, follower engagement and trust drop, credibility is spent, and the legacy knowledge the freeze needs stays withheld
consequence.es: El segundo movimiento más caro del modelo: confirma el temor del equipo sobre la nueva jefa, caen el compromiso y la confianza, se gasta credibilidad y el conocimiento heredado que el cierre necesita sigue retenido

name.en: Promising the veteran the next lead role in exchange for help now
name.es: Prometer a la veterana el próximo puesto de jefa a cambio de ayuda ahora

lure.en: It gets her cooperation and her legacy knowledge before Friday, and it feels generous to someone who has just been passed over
lure.es: Consigue su cooperación y su conocimiento heredado antes del viernes, y parece generoso con alguien a quien acaban de relegar

consequence.en: A debt the leader cannot pay: the promise is not hers to keep, so trust and credibility fall when it is tested, later than the cooperation it bought
consequence.es: Una deuda que la líder no puede pagar: la promesa no depende de ella, así que la confianza y la credibilidad caen cuando se pone a prueba, más tarde que la cooperación que compró

source.ref: TN §7 Q3, suggested analysis and likely positions (Promise her the next opening if she cooperates)

name.en: Projecting total certainty to the director
name.es: Proyectar certeza total ante el director

lure.en: The director asked her to establish herself, and showing no doubt in front of a steering committee looks like professional presence
lure.es: El director le pidió que se hiciera valer, y no mostrar dudas ante un comité de dirección parece presencia profesional

consequence.en: Self-awareness collapses while trust and follower engagement stay close to the disciplined run: authority is granted on a thin foundation, graded below Authority Earned
consequence.es: El autoconocimiento se hunde mientras la confianza y el compromiso quedan cerca de la partida disciplinada: autoridad concedida sobre cimientos frágiles, por debajo de Autoridad Ganada

source.ref: TN §7 Q4, §13 (Treating performed confidence as good leadership presence), §9.1 TN-Exhibit 4 Performed-confidence run

name.en: Keeping the freeze discussion open for one more round
name.es: Mantener abierto el debate del cierre una ronda más

lure.en: It feels fair and inclusive, nobody is overruled, and the room's mood stays good
lure.es: Parece justo e inclusivo, nadie queda arrollado y el ambiente de la sala sigue siendo bueno

consequence.en: The decision never closes before the steering committee: trust and decision quality fall and the week ends without authority earned, whatever the earlier rounds built
consequence.es: La decisión no se cierra antes del comité de dirección: caen la confianza y la calidad de decisión y la semana termina sin autoridad ganada, por mucho que construyeran las rondas anteriores

source.ref: TN §7 Q4 and §13 (Feeling good about an inclusive Round 4 that never decides); §9.1 TN-Exhibit 4 Abdicating run
